chapter_name: Foundations of Physical Education and Well-being
learning_objective: 🎯 You will learn the secrets of complete health, discover the building blocks of physical fitness, and understand how an active lifestyle powers your mind and body!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Health is not just about having big muscles or running fast! It is a magical mix of physical, mental, emotional, and social well-being. When your body is active, your mind is calm, you manage your feelings well, and you make great friends, you are experiencing true holistic health.

main_concepts.concept_title: 🏋️‍♂️ The Core Pillars of Physical Fitness
main_concepts.simple_explanation: To be super fit, your body needs four superpower skills. You need Strength to lift your heavy school bag, Endurance to play football without getting tired, Flexibility to bend and stretch easily, and a healthy Body Composition which is the perfect balance of muscle and fat.

Playing fair on the field is just as important as winning the game! Sportsmanship means respecting your teammates, following the referee's rules, and treating your opponents kindly. A true champion always stays humble in victory and positive in defeat.

Sitting for too long looking at screens can make our bodies lazy and weak. An active lifestyle means making smart daily choices like taking the stairs instead of the lift, playing outdoor games every evening, eating fresh colorful foods, and getting plenty of sleep to fight off modern health issues.

fun_activity.title: 🏆 The 10-Minute Home Fitness Challenge
fun_activity.instructions: Create a fun 10-minute workout routine using simple exercises like jumping jacks, squats, and stretches, then invite a family member to complete the challenge with you!

quick_recap: ⭐ True health is holistic, meaning it beautifully combines your physical, mental, emotional, and social well-being into one happy life.
⭐ You can build an amazing active lifestyle by moving your body every day, playing fair in sports, and eating healthy foods to stay strong.
